payload.title: Local evaluations and optimizations run without AWS credentials
payload.description:
As a Plexus operator, I want local evaluation and optimization workflows to use application-authorized artifacts, so that routine score improvement work does not depend on an AWS login.

Feature: Credential-free local evaluation and optimization

Scenario: Run an evaluation without AWS credentials
Given the user completed plexus login
And all AWS profile and session variables are absent
When an evaluation loads a stored reference dataset and persists its evidence
Then the evaluation completes through GraphQL and signed HTTPS artifact transfers
And no direct S3 client is created

Scenario: Run and resume an optimizer without AWS credentials
Given the user completed plexus login
And all AWS profile and session variables are absent
When a local optimizer checkpoints, stops, and resumes
Then procedure state and optimizer artifacts remain available in the dashboard
And no direct S3 client is created

Scenario: A required artifact transfer fails
Given a required artifact cannot be authorized, transferred, or verified
When the workflow reaches that artifact
Then the workflow fails with actionable evidence
And it does not use a storage fallback.
